hero.title: Shop It. Customize It. Own It.
hero.description: Whether you want something ready to wear or something made just for you—Qlozet gives you both. One platform. Endless possibilities.

marketplace.title: Discover Fashion From Top Designers
marketplace.description: Browse a curated marketplace of clothing, fabrics, and accessories from trusted vendors and emerging designers.

features.title: Shop across multiple brands in one place

custom.title: Made-to-Measure. Made for You.
custom.description: Design clothing that fits your exact body and your exact taste. No standard sizes. Just your size.

mixmatch.title: Create Without Limits
mixmatch.description: Qlozet lets you combine elements from different vendors into one outfit. You’re not restricted—you're empowered.

style.title: Your Style, Your Rules
style.description: Every piece—whether ready-made or custom—can align with your personal style. Fashion that reflects who you are.

fit.title: Powered by Your Fit Profile
fit.description: Every custom piece is created using your saved measurements, ensuring a consistent and perfect fit.

budget.title: Customize to Your Budget
budget.description: High-end fashion is no longer out of reach. Qlozet empowers you to tailor your garments not just to your body, but to your exact price point.

Change your styles to adjust the price

experience.title: From Selection to Creation
experience.description: Whether you’re shopping or designing, Qlozet keeps it simple. Effortless from start to finish.

steps.title: Browse or design your outfit
steps.description: Find what you love or start from scratch.

steps.title: Customize if needed

ecosystem.title: A Global Fashion Ecosystem
ecosystem.description: Qlozet connects customers with designers and vendors across regions—bringing diverse fashion styles into one platform.

closing.title: Why Choose Between Ready-Made and Custom?
closing.description: With Qlozet, you don’t have to. Shop what you love. Create what you imagine. Wear what truly fits.
